Bihar STET 2nd Dummy Admit Card 2026 – Full Details

Bihar School Examination Board (BSEB) has released the Dummy Admit Card for the Bihar State Teacher Eligibility STET Examination 2026 on the official website of the BSEB. Applications for the Bihar STET Online Form 2026 were accepted from 17 August 2026 – 22 September 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can check their Bihar STET Dummy Admit Card 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 17 August 2026
  • Last Date : 22 September 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 22 September 2026
  • 1st Dummy Admit Card : 25-30 September 2026
  • 2nd Dummy Admit Card : 01-07 October 2026
  • Exam Start : Notify Soon
  • Admit Card Available : Before Exam
  • Result : will be updated here soon

Application Fee

  • Paper I or Paper II
  • General, EWS, BC, EBC : Rs. 960/-
  • Other State (All Category) : Rs. 960/-
  • SC, ST, PWD : Rs. 760/-
  • Both Paper I & II
  • General, EWS, BC, EBC : Rs. 1440/-
  • Other State (All Category) : Rs. 1440/-
  • SC, ST, PWD : Rs. 1140/-

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Click on the official Admit Card link given below.
  2. Login using your Application Number / Roll Number and Password / DOB.
  3. Your Admit Card will be displayed on screen.
  4. Download the PDF and take a clear printout to carry to the exam venue.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is Bihar STET 2nd Dummy Admit Card 2026?

Bihar STET 2nd Dummy Admit Card 2026 is the official hall ticket for the upcoming examination. Candidates must carry it along with a valid photo ID to the exam centre.

Where can I find the official direct link?

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
